name: Bike Hop: Crazy BMX Bike Jump
summary:
Can you travel over the globe on your BMX bike? Easily! Hop on your bicycle, spin fast your pedals and fly far using a powerful jetpack on your back! Play Bike Hop, jump high and beat new records in this fun bicycle game! Embark on an extreme BMX bike adventure!

In this bike game, your goal is to fly as far as you can. The further your BMX boy flies, the more points you earn! Feel the real joy from freestyle extreme riding.

The Bike Hop controls are super easy! Tap to start cycling, tap again to speed up, and then tap one more time to jetpack jump from the ramp! Tap, tap, tap multiple times to use your jetpack flying over hills, cows, motorcycles, carts, and even entire cities. Use the jetpack fuel wisely and do not fall!
